post.caption:
Every ending scenario hangs on dark energy, and dark energy is essentially unexplained. The expansion is not slowing the way gravity says it should; it is accelerating. If that stays constant you get heat death, with everything spreading until nothing is close enough to anything for anything to happen. If it strengthens you get the Big Rip. If it reversed you get a Big Crunch. Current evidence favours continued expansion. All of it rests on something nobody can account for.
